div.head: Prom. Reg. 1.1
div.ab: án ærest, þæt Godes cyrice ⁊ eall Cristen folc minra gewealda soðe sibbe healde;
Imprimis, ut aecclesia Dei et omnis populus Christianus ueram pacem (nostro arbitrio) in omni tempore seruet.
án ærest, þæt Godes cyrice ⁊ eall Cristen folc minra gewealda soðe sibbe healde;
an ærest, þæt Godes cyrice and eall Cristen folc minra gewealda soðe sibbe healde;
Zum ersten, dass Gottes Kirche und das ganze Christenvolk meines Gebietes wahre Friedensruhe behalte;
First, that God's church and all the Christian people of my dominion shall keep true peace;
Firstly, that true peace shall be assured to the church of God and to all Christian people in my dominions.
first, that God’s Church and all the Christian people in my realm shall enjoy true peace;
div.note: Column O: Latin of the coronation liturgy.
